name: layout
role: the column layout of A and B announced before fit (for data.priors / systems(k).priors)

name: fit
role: the one user verb: fit(data, opts) -> Results

name: Options
role: the one settings object for fit (typed knobs with engine defaults)

name: Results
role: rich result object: solution, diagnostics, provenance, report()

name: engine.adjustNonlinear
role: Gauss-Newton with Levenberg damping on the block path

name: engine.batchSystem
role: a batch source as one local-free streaming system (the kind B/C adapter)

name: engine.adjustRobust
role: IRLS on the block path (every fit kind)

name: engine.adjustBlock
role: one GLS solve over the streaming block-arrow pipeline

name: engine.adjustVCEjoint
role: Ellmer ten-step joint co-estimation with keyed arc factors

name: engine.localColumns
role: the per-column (row day arc) unroll of a scoped local plan; read by layout / toTable / prior-group expansion

name: engine.makeLoader
role: day-builder -> Loader (built INSIDE fit from the data struct, R4-D4)

name: engine.BlockAccumulator
role: block-arrow accumulation with per-system Schur pre-elimination

name: engine.BlockCofactor
role: the cofactor of the full parameter set, kept as blocks (WP-86)

name: engine.CommonPrior
role: prior on the common block (regularisation as observations)

name: engine.verdict
role: the verdict of an adjustment: diagnostics, snooping, systematics, F test, ellipse (WP-86)

name: engine.declaration
role: the one declaration step of fit (validate + loaders)

name: engine.residuals
role: second data pass: residuals and quadratic forms

name: engine.gcvLambda
role: GCV choice of the regularisation weight

name: engine.mapreduce
role: serial / parfor / spmd task runner with ordered reduce

name: engine.resolveNc
role: common-parameter count derived from the systems

name: kernel.whittle
role: Whittle likelihood fit of a VAR model

name: kernel.stat
role: the distributions (normal, chi2, t, tau, F) and the test thresholds, base MATLAB only

name: kernel.hatACV
role: ACV of every bin of a piecewise-linear spectrum (the joint law's components)

name: kernel.decorrFactor
role: decorrelation factor of a dense covariance

name: kernel.redundancyLags
role: redundancy per lag without the dense W^-1

name: kernel.lawInverse
role: explicit inverse of an arc's covariance law (Trench / Cholesky)

name: kernel.wSnoop
role: Baarda's w per epoch with iterative data snooping (the robust statistic)

name: kernel.truncationDeficit
role: the redundancy a robust sample loses to its truncation per lag

name: util.callUser
role: call a user function: outputs counted once and errors wrapped with cause

name: util.toolboxVersion
role: the version string from Contents.m (runMeta provenance

name: util.onPass
role: fires Options.OnPass with the merged per-pass context

name: util.rowWeightKey
role: key convention for per-arc robust weights

name: util.priorStream
role: the prior pseudo-streams' obsType: made and recognised in one place (WP-138)

name: util.arcKey
role: the one arc key of the joint estimator (R7-43)

name: engine.runMeta
role: immutable provenance record for Results.meta (promoted from private, WP-64a)
